message: The other day, I was knee-deep in family chaos when my phone decided it was the perfect time to die. I panicked for a minute—how would I reach anyone? It was a gentle reminder of how important it is to have a backup plan, like a go-bag with important documents and a list of emergency contacts. Sometimes, the simplest things can help us feel a bit more prepared for the unexpected. How do you keep your family ready for surprises?
